title: Review-quality overhaul: structured findings + server-side verdict (item 1), verification ladder (item 2), method-angle procedures (item 3), deterministic risk router (item 4), shared-evidence prompt prefix (item 5) — 7 file-disjoint/serial-spine slices, all behavior-shifting pieces behind off->log->on, reviewer vocabulary mirroring Claude Code's /review skill
summary: Decompose the five prescribed changes into a 7-slice DAG that honors the issue's binding sequencing (prompt-only rules first, finding schema + server-side verdict next, risk router third, shared-evidence prefix last). Two file-disjoint roots (S1 prompts, S2 schema) run in parallel; the orchestrator-side work forms a serial spine because consensus_wrapper.py is a shared resource across items 1, 2-wrapper, and 4. Every behavior-shifting piece rides the off->log->on staged flag copied in shape from slice_green_gate.green_gate_mode() and fails safe to off. Reviewer prompt text, tiers, angles, verify ladder, finding shape, and gap sweep mirror Claude Code's built-in /review skill (reference comments on the issue) so egg's machinery stays interoperable. Cost is a first-class success criterion: the router defaults low-risk slices aggressively to cheaper /review tiers, and item 5's cache-hit rate + per-wave cost in log mode gate the flip to on.
problem_statement: egg's review machinery has the right skeleton (asymmetric review graph, deterministic ACK/NACK verdict, specialist lenses, adversarial tester, Delphi redaction, conditional ACK) but four gaps cost real currency: (1) prose-only NACKs burn revision rounds on unreproducible objections; (2) criteria say WHAT to look for but not HOW to search, and say nothing about deletions; (3) every slice gets every lens at full depth regardless of risk, and every reviewer in a wave cold-starts re-reading the same diff. This issue closes all four with five changes; no eval/benchmark harness and no human-feedback loop are in scope (single-operator deployment; operator judges quality directly).

verified_seams.review_graph: orchestrator/review_graph.py — ReviewEdge(reviewer_role, producer_role, criticality); get_review_graph_for_phase(phase, repo) is the SINGLE chokepoint every consumer calls (startup_reconciliation.py:310, kubernetes_monitor.py:933, kubernetes_spawner/_env.py:48, concurrent_executor.py:303, routes/consensus.py:139, routes/pipelines/_status_view.py:164, routes/pipelines/_prompt_phase.py:790, health_checks/tier1/*). It currently takes only (phase, repo) with no slice context — item 4's router MUST thread an optional per-slice risk/changed-file context through THIS function (or a sibling post-filter at the slice-scheduling seam) so all consumers see the gated graph consistently.
verified_seams.approval_matrix: orchestrator/approval_matrix.py — ApprovalEntry.reason is today a free-form NACK string (:36); conditional-ACK obligation fields already exist (obligation_*, #1998/#2336). Item 1's server-side verdict replaces the free-form reason-assignment path and routes advisory-only findings through the existing obligation_* fields.
verified_seams.consensus_wrapper: orchestrator/consensus_wrapper.py — injects EGG_EVENT_ACTION in {propose,ack,nack}; build_event_pump_wrapped_command(effort=...) already threads --effort per role (:642, :665). SHARED SERIAL RESOURCE across item 1 (render NACK reason), item 2 (per-finding tool-call cap), and item 4 (effort threading). No per-finding tool-call cap exists today.
verified_seams.effort_plumbing: orchestrator/agent_model_resolution.py — resolves per-role model/effort (effort: str | None, :324); --effort is threaded through the wrapper. No risk taxonomy drives it today; item 4 supplies one mapping onto the /review low/medium/high/xhigh ladder.
verified_seams.message_boundary_schema: shared/egg_contracts/ + orchestrator/attestation_schemas.py — the boundary-validated-contract precedent; item 1's finding schema lives here, versioned and evolved additively.
verified_seams.staged_flag: orchestrator/slice_green_gate.py::green_gate_mode() -> Literal['off','log','on'] — env-resolved, UNKNOWN VALUE FAILS TO 'off', 'log' records would-have-been behavior. Copy this shape verbatim for every behavior-shifting piece (S3, S4, S5, S6).
verified_seams.cacheable_prefix: orchestrator/routes/event_prompt/ — protected root, tail-position memory, prefix-budget caps; item 5 extends this discipline across sibling reviewers in a wave.
verified_seams.conditional_ack: docs/reference/conditional-ack.md — advisory-obligation path item 1 reuses for advisory-only findings.
verified_seams.repo_config: shared/egg_config/config.py — repositories.yaml at ~/.config/egg/; .egg/phase-permissions.json — the per-repo/per-glob config conventions item 4's risk config mirrors.

reference_design.source: Claude Code built-in /review skill, extracted verbatim from the 2.1.201 binary, validated byte-identical against a live session. Full text: issue #3523 comments issuecomment-4898679999 (four effort bodies) + issuecomment-4898686738 (assembled example). BINDING operator directive: mirror this structure rather than invent a bespoke vocabulary so egg stays interoperable.
reference_design.tier_ladder_to_item4: low (1 diff pass, no verify, hunk-only, no subagents, cap 4, test files skipped, forbidden from flagging outside the hunk — this IS the docs-only minimal graph, a genuinely different design not a smaller fan-out) / medium (3+5 angles x6, 1-vote verify, precision stance, cap 8) / high (same fan-out, recall-biased verify, cap 10) / xhigh=max (5+5 angles x8, recall, cap 15, plus a gap sweep).
reference_design.angles_to_item3: Correctness: A line-by-line diff scan (enclosing function per hunk), B removed-behavior auditor, C cross-file tracer (grep callers + check callees), D language-pitfall (xhigh), E wrapper/proxy correctness (xhigh). Cleanup: reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude, conventions (quote-the-rule). Load-bearing rule: pass EVERY candidate with a nameable failure scenario through to verify; finders silently dropping half-believed candidates are the dominant cause of misses.
reference_design.verify_to_item2: CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED with per-tier stance: medium=precision; high='PLAUSIBLE by default, REFUTED only when constructible from the code'; xhigh='a single non-REFUTED vote carries the finding'.
reference_design.finding_shape_to_item1: file, line, one-sentence summary, REQUIRED concrete failure_scenario (concrete inputs/state -> wrong output/crash). Cleanup findings reuse the shape with concrete cost in failure_scenario. Correctness outranks cleanup at the cap; ranked most-severe first; empty result explicit [].

roots_parallel: S2 shared/egg_contracts/ finding schema (new module, file-disjoint)
slice_dag_guidance.serial_spine: S3 -> S4 -> S5 all touch orchestrator/consensus_wrapper.py (NACK rendering / tool-call cap / effort threading) and CANNOT run concurrently under #3046. S6 depends on S5. S7 (docs) is the tail.
slice_dag_guidance.chain: S1 || S2  ->  S3 (needs S2)  ->  S4 (needs S2,S3)  ->  S5 (needs S3)  ->  S6 (needs S3,S5)  ->  S7 (all)
slice_dag_guidance.absorption_options: task_planner MAY split S1 into two serial sub-slices (2-ladder across all criteria; 3-angles in code-review) and MAY absorb S4 into S3; both are noted in the slices YAML. Architect recommends the 7-slice cut for reviewability; task_planner owns the final DAG.
slice_dag_guidance.note: This is a SINGLE-repo (egg) feature pipeline; the slice<->repo rule does not apply. The dominant constraint is #3046 file-level overlap on consensus_wrapper.py.

architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.slice_cut_points: Resolved in the 7-slice DAG above; sequencing is fixed by the issue.
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.schema_field_encoding: JSON schema in shared/egg_contracts/ whose CORE mirrors the /review finding shape (file/line/summary/required failure_scenario) with egg extensions added ADDITIVELY: id, role, anchor (path+line_range OR slice-level), severity in {blocking,advisory}, confidence in {high,medium,low}, quoted evidence, optional suggested_patch, optional pre-merge obligation, and a schema_version field. Evolve additively; boundary-validated like attestation_schemas.py.
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.router_config_format: Per-repo YAML (recommended path .egg/review-risk.yaml) mapping path-globs -> {lenses, tier}, resolved by most-specific-glob / deterministic first-match, mirroring phase-permissions.json + repositories.yaml conventions. No-match => full graph + loud warning (fail-safe).
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.evidence_gatherer_packaging: A NEW unprivileged role in the agent registry with NO GitHub/verdict/post capability (structurally absent, not merely unused), producing the evidence pack as a per-slice artifact consumed by the prompt-assembly layer in routes/event_prompt/.

binding_invariants: failure_scenario is REQUIRED to block; a blocking finding missing it degrades to advisory and NEVER errors.
The edge verdict is a PURE, unit-tested function of findings: any blocking => NACK; advisory-only => conditional-ACK (existing obligation_* path); empty => ACK.
The legacy prose-NACK path stays live until item 1's schema flag is 'on'.

Every behavior-shifting piece (S3 verdict, S4 tool-call cap, S5 router, S6 prefix) rides off->log->on copied in shape from green_gate_mode(); unknown value fails safe to 'off'; 'log' records would-have-been behavior into existing BRC artifacts.

Router no-match => FULL graph + loud warning (missing config must never mean less review); the security lens is structurally UN-gatable on auth/session/input-boundary paths; a floor tier guarantees a misrouted risky slice still gets a real review; cost-cutting never overrides these floors.
Evidence pack: EVIDENCE, NEVER CONCLUSIONS — mechanically path-ordered, byte-identical across a wave; no hypotheses/areas-of-concern/importance-ordering.

The tester and any finding-VERIFIER stay COLD-START (a verifier must not inherit the context that produced the claim); Delphi redaction is UNCHANGED (pack carries repo facts, never the producer's self-assessment).
Item 5 flips to 'on' ONLY after a MEASURED net cost reduction in 'log' mode (cache-hit rate + per-wave cost are explicit acceptance criteria, not afterthoughts).
Reviewer prompts (items 2-4) mirror the Claude Code /review vocabulary: tier ladder, finder angles, 3-state verify, finding schema, xhigh gap sweep.
Adversarial diff content funneled through the single gatherer is material under review, NEVER instructions (existing untrusted-input posture applies to the pack).

Cost is a FIRST-CLASS success criterion: the router defaults low-risk slices to the cheaper /review tiers rather than always running the full graph; per-wave token cost is measured and reported for items 4 and 5 in log mode.
open_questions_note: None registered. The issue is a complete, prescriptive operator directive (five changes, per-field schema, sequencing, staged-flag rollout, floor/independence guardrails, out-of-scope boundary all fixed by the issue text + the two operator directives). The four previously-deferred choices (slice cut-points, schema field encoding, router config format, gatherer packaging) are implementation-level and resolved above as architect decisions — they do NOT rise to operator HITL. The ONE candidate future scope fork the issue itself names is item 5's shared-prefix fork point proving too shallow; if the plan/implement phase finds the raw-evidence pack insufficient, THAT is raised as a plan-phase HITL decision at that point, not pre-emptively.

risk_assessment.risk: Determinism-boundary regression (item 1): moving verdict computation server-side changes today's ACK/NACK outcomes.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Verdict is a pure, unit-tested function of findings; log mode diffs computed-vs-legacy verdict without acting; legacy path stays until flag is on.

risk_assessment.risk: Router silently under-reviews (item 4): a glob gap drops a critical lens.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Floor tier + no-match-runs-full-graph + loud warning + log-first rollout; security lens structurally un-gatable on auth/input-boundary paths.

risk_assessment.risk: Anchoring via the shared pack (item 5): an editorializing gatherer collapses convergence-as-signal.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hard evidence-never-conclusions rule; mechanical path ordering; cold-start tester/verifier; unchanged Delphi redaction; item 1's convergence metric makes anchoring regressions visible.

risk_assessment.risk: Prompt-cache fragility (item 5): any non-identical prefix byte voids the cache win.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Assemble the prefix deterministically; measure real hit-rate in log mode before on; net-cost-reduction gate on the flip.

risk_assessment.risk: Untrusted-input surface concentration (item 5): one gatherer funnels adversarial diff text to all lenses.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Pack is data-not-instructions per the existing untrusted-input posture.

risk_assessment.risk: consensus_wrapper.py contention: S3/S4/S5 all edit it and could race under concurrent scheduling.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Declared a serial spine in the DAG; dependencies enforce S3->S4->S5 ordering so they never run concurrently.

acceptance_criteria_direction: Versioned finding schema in shared/egg_contracts/, boundary-validated; failure_scenario required for a blocking finding; verdict computed deterministically server-side (blocking=>NACK, advisory-only=>conditional-ACK, empty=>ACK); mechanism dedup attaches >=2 producers.

Shared criteria carry CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE/REFUTED, 'blocking must reproduce', 'drop only refuted / downgrade unconfirmed', the amplified-pre-existing-defect nuance, and a scratch-check permission; a per-finding tool-call cap is enforced in the wrapper where feasible.
code-review-criteria.md names the four method-angle procedures, including the deletion (removed-behavior) audit.
Deterministic risk router + per-repo config gates lenses and sets effort tiers via the existing --effort plumbing; no-match => full graph + warning; floor tier guaranteed; log-first.

Read-only evidence gatherer + byte-identical, mechanically-ordered shared prefix; tester and finding-verifier stay cold-start; Delphi redaction unchanged; flag-gated; log mode records cache-hit rate + per-wave cost, and a measured net cost reduction gates the flip to on.
Every behavior-shifting piece rides off->log->on and fails safe to off.
Cost is a first-class success criterion: router defaults low-risk slices to lower /review tiers; per-wave token cost measured and reported for items 4 and 5 in log mode.
Reviewer prompts (items 2-4) mirror the Claude Code /review skill vocabulary (tier ladder, finder angles, 3-state verify, finding schema, xhigh gap sweep).
